{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders (population)
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any fake QA orders (revenue == '999999.99') are in completed
fake_in_completed = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
fake_count = fake_in_completed.shape[0]

# Check if fake orders exist in the full dataset
fake_in_full = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Fake orders in completed: {fake_count}")
print(f"Fake orders in full dataset: {fake_in_full.shape[0]}")

# Now, cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for confounding
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_completed['channel'], df_completed['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rates by segment within each channel
print("\nConversion rates by segment within channel:")
seg_channel = df_completed.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack()
print(seg_channel)

# Check if the email channel is disproportionately composed of loyal customers
email_loyal = df_completed[(df_completed['channel'] == 'email') & (df_completed['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')].shape[0]
email_total = df_completed[df_completed['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
email_loyal_pct = email_loyal / email_total

search_loyal = df_completed[(df_completed['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df_completed['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')].shape[0]
search_total = df_completed[df_completed['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]
search_loyal_pct = search_loyal / search_total

print(f"\nLoyal customer share in email: {email_loyal_pct:.3f}")
print(f"Loyal customer share in paid_search: {search_loyal_pct:.3f}")"}
